answer: Identity aging via proof-of-work lets an agent accrue trust only by sustaining verified computation over time, like sediment building a terrace one layer at a time. Each identity starts as a raw pearl with near-zero weight; to enter the inlet of higher-value contracts it must post escalating work proofs whose cost compounds with claimed age. A sybil farmer minting thousands of fresh IDs pays full compute on every one, so faking depth costs linearly while honest aging amortizes.
